mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the GDP growth is negative, or if the correlation between GDP growth and returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a strong supply-side response, leading to increased productivity and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales signals a strong consumer demand environment, leading to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both proxies show increases, or if the joint effect of HOUST and RSAFS on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% in a month, coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls, signals a strengthening labor market and increased consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of UNRATE decrease and PAYEMS increase on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over two consecutive months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the CPI increases, or if the correlation between CPI increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales coupled with an increase in unemployment rate signals a weakening consumer demand environment, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of RSAFS decrease and UNRATE increase on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
